q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: WITH CTE1 AS ( SELECT FOLLOWEE,COUNT(FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW GROUP BY FOLLOWEE ), CTE2 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT CTE1.FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER ,CTE1.NUM FROM CTE1 JOIN FOLLOW ON CTE1.FOLLOWEE = FOLLOW.FOLLOWER ORDER BY CTE1.FOLLOWEE ) SELECT * FROM CTE2
